value.rationale: Two opposite-direction cars are the smallest interacting BML system and create a natural dilute limit. The exact gcd trichotomy gives a sharp arithmetic obstruction to self-organization at densities tending to zero, resolves every initial placement, and produces exact individual speed deficits and collision counts. This substantively distinguishes square-grid low-car theorems from rectangular situations, rather than adding an unmotivated parameter slice.
